units: <cite ref="Mishnah Makkot 3:6">Macc. III, 6</cite> <he>כתב ולא ק׳ ק׳ … וִיקַעְקֵעַ</he> if he writes (on his skin) but makes no impression, or makes an impression but does not write, he is not guilty (of trespassing the law, <cite ref="Leviticus 19:28">Lev. XIX, 28</cite>) until he writes and stamps with ink &c.; Sifra K’doshim, Par. 3, ch. VI; a. e.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 4:4:10">Y. Ab. Zar. IV, 44ᵃ</cite> top, a. e., v. <cite ref="B00679"><he>בֵּיצָה</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Tosefta Bava Kamma 10:5">Tosef. B. Kam. X, 5</cite>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Gittin 5:6:5">Y. Gitt. V, 47ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>יְקַעְקֵעַ כל הבירה וכ׳</he> he must (if necessary) take down the entire group of buildings in order to restore it (the stolen beam).

<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 35:5">Ex. R. s. 35</cite> <he>החריבה אותו אלא שלא קִעְקְעָה אותו וכ׳</he> she (Babylon) laid the Temple in ruins, but she did not stamp it out, whereas of Edom it is written (<cite ref="Psalms 137:7">Ps. CXXXVII, 7</cite>), ‘raze it, raze it &c.’

<cite ref="Esther Rabbah 2:10">Esth. R. to I, 7</cite> <he>מי גרם … שתִּתְקַעְקֵעַ ביצתו וכ׳</he> what was the cause that Belshazzar’s dynasty was entirely exterminated? <cite ref="Ruth Rabbah 7:15">Ruth R. to IV, 14</cite> <he>מברכותיהן … לא נִתְקַעְקְעָה ביצתו וכ׳</he> owing to the blessings of the women, the seed of David was not entirely exterminated in the days of Athaliah.
<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 12:1">Pesik. R. s. 12</cite> <he>ואימתי שמשו שוקעת וביצתו מִתְקַעְקַעַת וכ׳</he> and when shall his (Amalek’s) sun go down and his egg be stamped out and his seed uprooted?
